mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are seeing clear skies across the area, particularly beautiful over at Verona Community Park, with a comfortable temperature of 78 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that sewer and stormwater utility rates have been adjusted to keep services self-supporting, and the city is also actively seeking an Engineering Technician to oversee municipal construction projects.
There is plenty to do today, including Concerts in the Park at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia, with live music continuing tomorrow at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly report, a notable incident occurred on Friday, August 15, when officers arrested a driver for an O W I offence after they were found unresponsive in their vehicle.
The Culver's Flavor of the Day is the mouth-watering Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant is open until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to grab a scoop.
